learning_rule: Frozen SONIC and contact teacher; 50Hz same-player proprioceptive receive phase actor. Candidate 0 reproduces previous parent. Seven local and four broad seeded parameter perturbations are evaluated against real 500Hz six-G1 contact and all-body safety. Old two-scene dynamic second-foot performance is a hard retention gate. New scenes must gain at least one clean, dynamic first foot without increasing unsafe or shin-first outcomes. Sealed Fresh8 is never used for training.
